Definition: from G3844 and G3598; a by-road, i.e. (actively) a route:--way.
BiblicalUsage: Parodos is a by-road, a way through. Paul uses it once, in 1 Corinthians 16:7, where he says he will not see the Corinthians now by the way, but trusts to tarry a while with them, if the Lord permit.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Paul would not pass through by the way when he could stay a while, and the church deserves more than a traveller's greeting.
